T.E.R | The Essential Ritual:

• Brand Introduction:

T.E.R | The Essential Ritual is an online retailer specializing in premium Korean and Japanese skincare products. We are committed to curating high-quality, authentic beauty solutions that promote healthy, radiant skin. With fast shipping from the USA and a passion for customer satisfaction, T.E.R Glow is dedicated to elevating skincare routines with luxurious and effective products.

• Product Description:

Our collection includes a wide range of top-tier Korean and Japanese skincare products, handpicked for their proven effectiveness and quality ingredients. Our offerings include:

  • Cleansers, Toners, Serums, and Moisturizers

  • Facial Masks, Ampoules, and Essences

  • Beauty Tools: Gua Sha, Jade Rollers, and more

  • Hair Care and Self-Care Essentials

We prioritize brands known for their innovation and results, including COSRX, BRMUD, SKIN1004, Aestura, and more.

• USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • Authentic Korean and Japanese Beauty Products: Directly sourced from Korea, ensuring quality and authenticity.

  • Fast USA Shipping: Quick delivery from our US-based warehouses.

  • Curated Selection: Focused on best-sellers and trending products for optimal skincare.

  • Sustainability Focus: Eco-friendly packaging and commitment to sustainable sourcing.

  • Customer-Centric Service: Exceptional support and a satisfaction guarantee with every purchase.

• Payment Terms:

  • Accepted Methods: Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, AmEx), PayPal, and Apple Pay.

  • Net Terms for Wholesale: Available upon request for B2B partners.

  • Return Policy: 30-day satisfaction guarantee for unused and unopened products.

  • Refund Processing: Handled within 7–10 business days upon approval.

• Other Information:

  • Website: TERGlow.com

  • Contact Information: Minh Nguyen | mn@terglow.com | 943-888-1211

  • Social Media Presence: Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest—regularly updated with beauty tips, product launches, and skincare routines.

  • Wholesale Opportunities: Open for discussion with global distributors and local retailers.

  • Eco-Friendly Initiatives: We prioritize sustainable packaging and cruelty-free products.
